Info

Defines FrameHeaderFormatter formatting wire protocol frame header parameters.

class scaralang.infrastructure.command.compile.inspection.framing.frame_header_formatter.FrameHeaderFormatter[source]¶

Bases: object

Formats wire frame header fields into human-readable description.

It defines:

methods:
format_header - Formats header delimiters, message, sequence, and length.
get_version - Returns the component version string.
format_header(*, msg_id: MessageId, seq_num: int, payload_len: int) → str[source]¶

Formats wire frame header fields into human-readable description.

Parameters:

  • msg_id – Wire frame message identifier.

  • seq_num – Cyclic frame sequence number.

  • payload_len – Length of payload in bytes.

Returns:

Formatted wire header string.
